text:
Nina (Design): quick usability note from hallway testing: people expect a faster path from the roles matrix to recent events. many scanned the row and then opened a new tab to search audit manually.
Owen (Product): thanks. is the ask an inline link, a keyboard shortcut, or a floating quick-action? pros/cons?
Nina (Design): leaning toward two affordances: an inline micro-link for mouse users and a keyboard shortcut for power users. keep the inline minimal: 'Open audit' (10px label) next to role metadata.
Rohit (Engineering): keyboard shortcut is doable, but we need to avoid global collisions. suggest `Shift+A` when a row has focus/selection. Implementation: row sets `data-selected-role` then a global key listener triggers deep-link `/orgs/:id/audit?role=...&from=matrix`.
Lena (Accessibility): important: shortcuts must be discoverable and opt-out friendly. add a tooltip/hint: "Shift+A to open audit for selected role" and a settings toggle to disable shortcuts. announce on open: "Opened audit for role Admin, 9 events" via aria-live.
Marco (Support): also note: customers reported confusion when SSO changes don't show in audit context. if someone toggles SSO on in invite flow, they expect to see that event at the top of audit. need to surface that.
Nina (Design): design idea: when opening audit from a role, show a compact filter pill bar above results: e.g., "Filters: role=Admin". When coming from invite or SSO toggle, prepend "Filters: [SSO change]" as a highlighted pill. Example mock: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz4321/roles-to-audit-shortcuts-frame (frame 12).
Rohit (Engineering): backend: audit API already supports filter tags. We'll add a `source_context` param (matrix|invite|sso-toggle) to aid sorting and telemetry. Also implement anchor + query string navigation, no extra server calls on click.
Owen (Product): microcopy discussion: "Open audit" vs "View audit" vs "Audit (role)". Which reads best inline?
Lena (Accessibility): "Open audit" slightly more action-y; screen readers will read the surrounding role name. Recommend visible text: "Open audit" + visually-hidden string: "for role {role name}".
Nina (Design): good. Add a tiny chevron icon to indicate navigation. Keep color muted (#6b7280) and underline on hover for clarity.
Rohit (Engineering): keyboard handling sketch:
```js
// when a role row is selected
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.shiftKey && e.code === 'KeyA') {
    const roleId = document.querySelector('[data-row-selected]')?.dataset.roleId;
    if (roleId) navigate(`/orgs/${orgId}/audit?role=${roleId}&from=matrix`);
  }
});
```
Lena (Accessibility): ensure shortcut is documented in keyboard help and doesn't interfere with editor inputs. use `event.target` checks and `e.preventDefault()` carefully. Also ensure focus lands in results region with `tabindex=-1` and `role=region` + `aria-label="Audit results"`.
Marco (Support): request: when jump happens, add a tiny inline note above results: "Context: navigated from Roles > Manager" so users know why filters applied. Helps when triaging tickets.
Nina (Design): will include that context chip design; make it dismissible with an `x` and keyboard accessible.
Owen (Product): rollout plan? recommend feature flag behind `roles_audit_quicklink`, enable for 5% of orgs first. collect these metrics: shortcut usage rate, inline link CTR, time-to-first-result, and support ticket mentions.
Rohit (Engineering): rough ETA: spike for keyboard pattern + accessibility testing (1d), implement inline link + chip (2d), add shortcut + settings toggle (2d), QA (1d). I'll open the ticket.
Nina (Design): I'll update mocks and hover states, and add the visually-hidden copy for SRs.
Lena (Accessibility): I'll prepare a checklist: tab order, screenreader announcement, shortcut discoverability, focus trap avoidance. I'll test with NVDA + VoiceOver.
Rohit (Engineering): PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1011 contains router parsing, query param mapping, and the keyboard listener (disabled behind flag).
Owen (Product): final microcopy: inline = "Open audit" + visually-hidden "for role {name}". Shortcut hint = "Shift+A" in tooltip.
Nina (Design): added note: for invite flow, when user completes invite with SSO on, show a tiny toast linking to audit: "See audit for invite" this can use the same deep-link.
Marco (Support): that's helpful. reduces "where did my invite go" tickets.
Owen (Product): action items: Rohit - ticket + PR, Nina - update Figma + assets, Lena - accessibility checklist & smoke tests, Marco - prepare support KB blurb. We'll canary at 5% and review after 2 weeks.
